policy: Only records whose official awarding-body page states the programme is discontinued are removed. A passed deadline alone is never grounds for removal; the other 151 closed-labelled published records (recurring, temporarily closed, upcoming/current, uncertain) stay published on their last researched state. No record is hard-deleted; each is archived with this ledger as the exportable reason.

removals.title: NORPART – Norwegian Partnership Programme
removals.evidence_quote: Grants you can apply for now: 0 ... The Norwegian government has proposed to end support for the NORPART-programme in the 2025 National Budget. This means that only around seven projects will receive funding in the planned allocation in October, based on the NOK 35 million that was allocated to the programme for 2024. ... Results of the call for applications 2024 The deadline for the call for proposals for 2024 was 3. June.
removals.why_removed: The awarding body (HK-dir) publishes zero open grants and states the Norwegian government has proposed to end support for the programme. The last call closed 3 June 2024 and no successor call exists. The scheme funds institutional partnerships, not individual students, so it was never an applicant-facing scholarship.

removals.title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarship
removals.evidence_quote: We are no longer accepting applications for the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships. Please refer to the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral program web page for information regarding the new harmonized program.
removals.why_removed: The official programme page states applications are no longer accepted and points to the harmonized successor. The successor (Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral) is already published in the catalogue as active record id 306, so this removal costs applicants no discoverable opportunity and the successor needs no replacement record.
